scripts.demo: npm install && npm run db:reset && npm run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p scripts && tsc -p e2e
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.test:pg: test -n "$TEST_DATABASE_URL" || { echo "test:pg precisa de TEST_DATABASE_URL (ex.: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:54329/postgres)"; exit 1; } && vitest run --project server server/test/credentials.test.ts server/test/rateLimit.test.ts server/test/cron.test.ts server/test/limits.test.ts server/test/migrations.test.ts
